subarea.label: Obligations, Payments, Allocation and Settlement
subarea.description: Monetary obligations, payments, allocations, fees and settlement.

accepted_offer.definition: The offer(s) -- e.g., product, quantity and price combinations -- included in the order.

account_id.definition: The identifier for the account the payment will be applied to.

billing_address.definition: The billing address for the order.

billing_period.definition: The time interval used to compute the invoice.

broker.definition: An entity that arranges for an exchange between a buyer and a seller.  In most cases a broker never acquires or releases ownership of a product or service involved in an exchange.  If it is not clear whether an entity is a broker, seller, or buyer, the latter two terms are preferred.

category.definition: A category for the item. Greater signs or slashes can be used to informally indicate a category hierarchy.

confirmation_number.definition: A number that confirms the given order or payment has been received.

currency.definition: The currency in which the monetary amount is expressed.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

customer.definition: Party placing the order or paying the invoice.

discount_code.definition: Code used to redeem a discount.

discount_currency.definition: The currency of the discount.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

fees_and_commissions_specification.definition: Description of fees, commissions, and other terms applied either to a class of financial product, or by a financial service organization.

is_gift.definition: Indicates whether the offer was accepted as a gift for someone other than the buyer.

max_value.definition: The upper value of some characteristic or property.

min_value.definition: The lower value of some characteristic or property.

minimum_payment_due.definition: The minimum payment required at this time.

order_delivery.definition: The delivery of the parcel related to this order or order item.

order_status.definition: The current status of the order.

part_of_invoice.definition: The order is being paid as part of the referenced Invoice.

payment_due.definition: The date that payment is due.

payment_means_id.definition: An identifier for the method of payment used (e.g. the last 4 digits of the credit card).

payment_method.definition: The name of the credit card or other method of payment for the order.

payment_status.definition: The status of payment; whether the invoice has been paid or not.

payment_url.definition: The URL for sending a payment.

price.definition:
The offer price of a product, or of a price component when attached to PriceSpecification and its subtypes.

Usage guidelines:

* Use the [[priceCurrency]] property (with standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR") instead of including [ambiguous symbols](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dollar_sign#Currencies_that_use_the_dollar_or_peso_sign) such as '$' in the value.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.
* Note that both [RDFa](http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml-rdfa-primer/#using-the-content-attribute) and Microdata syntax allow the use of a "content=" attribute for publishing simple machine-readable values alongside more human-friendly formatting.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.

price_currency.definition: The currency of the price, or a price component when attached to [[PriceSpecification]] and its subtypes.\n\nUse standard formats: [ISO 4217 currency format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_4217), e.g. "USD"; [Ticker symbol](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_cryptocurrencies) for cryptocurrencies, e.g. "BTC"; well known names for [Local Exchange Trading Systems](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Local_exchange_trading_system) (LETS) and other currency types, e.g. "Ithaca HOUR".

provider.definition: The service provider, service operator, or service performer; the goods producer. Another party (a seller) may offer those services or goods on behalf of the provider. A provider may also serve as the seller.

references_order.definition: The Order(s) related to this Invoice. One or more Orders may be combined into a single Invoice.

scheduled_payment_date.definition: The date the invoice is scheduled to be paid.

seller.definition: An entity which offers (sells / leases / lends / loans) the services / goods.  A seller may also be a provider.

value__6cd2a6da.definition:
The value of a [[QuantitativeValue]] (including [[Observation]]) or property value node.

* For [[QuantitativeValue]] and [[MonetaryAmount]], the recommended type for values is 'Number'.
* For [[PropertyValue]], it can be 'Text', 'Number', 'Boolean', 'StructuredValue' or 'QualitativeValue'.
* Use values from 0123456789 (Unicode 'DIGIT ZERO' (U+0030) to 'DIGIT NINE' (U+0039)) rather than superficially similar Unicode symbols.
* Use '.' (Unicode 'FULL STOP' (U+002E)) rather than ',' to indicate a decimal point. Avoid using these symbols as a readability separator.

candidate_concepts.source_definition: A type of legal description for land in developed areas where streets or other rights-of-ways delineate large parcels of land referred to as divided into lots on which homes or other types of developments are built. An example would read "Lot 12 of Block 45 of Tract 3002 of the City of San Dunes, Desert County." Such a description would also reference an official plat filed with the clerk or recorder for that area which shows the location of the block and often the dimensions of the lots therein.
The year in which the last assessment of the property value/tax was made.
